shots.image_prompt: Igor stands at the kitchen island holding a small open jewellery box, looking at it with suspicion. Anna walks in from the left carrying a handbag, stopping mid-step.
shots.motion_prompt: Igor slowly turns his head from the box to Anna; Anna freezes and slightly lowers her bag.

lines.text: Анна, это что? Я нашёл это в твоей сумке, когда искал ключи.

shots.image_prompt: Tight two-shot across the kitchen island: Igor on the left holding the jewellery box up between them, Anna on the right with crossed arms, annoyed expression.

lines.text: Я искал ключи. Это серьги за сорок тысяч. Откуда они?

shots.image_prompt: Close-up of a paper receipt lying on the white kitchen island next to the open jewellery box with gold earrings.
shots.insert_text: a store receipt with the header "JEWELRY STORE" and the line "PAID BY CARD **** 4417 — 40 000 RUB"

lines.text: Тогда почему чек оплачен с нашей общей карты?

shots.image_prompt: Close-up of Anna, caught off guard, eyes wide, lips parted, one hand touching her necklace.
shots.motion_prompt: Anna blinks, swallows, and looks down, then back up.

lines.text: Я… я хотела тебе всё объяснить.
